value.rationale: Asymptotic orbital period and geometric convergence to the heteroclinic boundary do not quantify how long a near-boundary orbit spends with particular exponentially rare species. The explicit weighted log-coordinate triangle and three atom-plus-uniform marginals identify physical-time minority exposure scales, with a quantitative W1 guarantee, for all positive fixed coefficients. This is a natural new observable of cyclic competition and not a trivial coefficient renaming.
